diff#

The differences between two lists of lines, as unified or context diffs.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let changes = Diff(left: old_lines, right: new_lines);
changes.unified();          // "--- left\n+++ right\n@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@\n …"
changes.unified(0);         // without context lines
changes.contextual();       // the context format
changes.ratio();            // 1.0 when equal
for changes.edits() -> edit { edit::Line::kind; }

Description#

The differences between two lists of lines, as unified or context diffs.

Equal lists give an empty diff. Context is 0 to 64 lines, 3 unless told.

object Diff#

object Diff

Diff compares two sequences of lines, once, and answers in several forms.

let changes = Diff(left: before, right: after);
changes.unified();              // unified text, 3 lines of context
changes.unified(1);
changes.contextual();           // the context format
changes.ratio();                // 0.0 .. 1.0, as difflib's ratio()
for changes.edits() -> edit {
    edit::Line::kind;           // equal, removed or added
}

Equal inputs print as "". Context is 0..64 lines. A comparison that would exceed the work budget throws DiffLimitExceeded.
